reviewer: qa_ledger agent (independent implementation reviewer; not human initial play)
method: Read canonical requirements and implementation; inspect current source contracts, source/delivery registry and acquisition pipeline; verify all compressed files and label/ID coverage; inspect live test evidence.

checks.observation: All 4845 source objects are source_only/gameAdded=false with distinct cityLod/renderLod, unique IDs, valid compressed and raw hashes. 292 source-height-zero records are excluded from runtime.
4845 asset rows cover all 4845 compressed source object IDs; raw source hashes/CRC are separately validated in data/validation.json.
10 identified road sections and 20 identified building sites include source positions/views; all independent references, dates, uncertainties and measured values remain explicitly unverified.

Inspected acquisition scripts, source registry and delivery. Only the documented Gifu PLATEAU source archive is adopted; no separately sourced BIM, OSM or GSI product and no Google mesh/Street View extraction are used. Conditional supplemental-source terms remain applicable on future adoption.

Inspected main, race, environment, audio and package dependencies. Initial version has no online multiplayer, whole-Japan continuity, interiors, whole-building destruction, excavation, traffic or pedestrian simulation. Density/force/fragment/grip parameters are explicitly arcade tuning; source structural safety attributes are not substituted.

Source static/destructible meshes retain source IDs/vertices; authored game additions are explicit. Per-piece paint and broken state survive resource reconstruction, while reset restores the original world. Source data file bytes are not changed by gameplay.

Geodata, physical environment, race and QA agents worked concurrently and reviewed integrated boundaries. Concrete findings fixed include stale Rapier handles, source bench and wall fragmentation pinning, explicit pause vs focus-loss toggle, duplicate build assets, pickup color-only distinction, and incomplete stress metrics. Gate/decision docs retain unapproved scope decisions and full-acceptance check refuses incomplete rows.

limits: No surveyed precision was inferred from this audit.
No 3D browser play, gamepad handling or target GPU performance was claimed.
Third-party sculpture/monument rights and near-view textures remain unresolved.
Physical runtime test results are recorded separately; a code review does not replace missing execution.
